sections.Profile:
Choose Lucy MacLean, the Ghoul or Maximus and play through the Prime Video series' story, with music and sound pulled from Fallout 3, Fallout 4 and New Vegas. Keith Elwin's most ambitious layout puts a working Pip-Boy on the playfield, a Fat Man launcher firing into a Wasteland shooting gallery, an inverted upper flipper, and, on the Premium and LE, a Vault 33 lower playfield driven by Magna-Flip magnets.

- Manufacturer: Stern Pinball Inc.
- Years made: 2026
- In production: yes
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 4
- Tags: 2020s, Solid State

sections.Getting Started (Kineticist tutorial):
- Character select — choose between Lucy, Maximus, or The Ghoul at the start of the game. Lucy makes vaults easier. Maximus makes fusion core / 2x scoring easier. The Ghoul reduces damage from radroaches.
- Skill shot / cap stash — plunge the flashing inlane to briefly lower the spinner for a cap stash rip. The inlanes can also be completed during single-ball play to light cap stash. Cap stash is the main way of earning currency to spend at sundries.
- Quests — shoot the left orbit or right ramp to add HP and enable quests at the scoop. Junk target changes lit quest. Radscorpion Attack — shots light jump ramp mode. Mind Control — ramps light spinner mode. NOVAC — left orbit / right ramp combo mode. Find the Target — all shots are lit, hit enough to light scoop then right ramp / Pip-Boy to complete mode. Wedding Day and The Kings are 2-ball multiballs where balls can be added with enough Deathclaw hits. Quest completion awards legendary weapons.
- Wasteland items — shoot the left orbit, U-turn, and right ramp to collect items in the following order: stimpak (outlane ball save), companion (passive scoring buffs along with an action button buff, once per level up), light side quest (as the next mode started at the scoop).
- Deathclaw Multiball — time Deathclaw hits when "FIRE!" is flashing to start. First multiball is jackpot build / collect where the Deathclaw lights on a timer after the build phase is finished. Second multiball is switch-based where all switches build and eventually light the Deathclaw for jackpot. Upgrade weapons by collecting junk to re-enable Deathclaw for multiball progress.
- Wasteland Multiball — high-scoring but tough to start. Nuke targets light the Pip-Boy to load the nuke launcher. Either hit all three flashing nuke targets (Pro) or use the launcher to hit all three upper playfield targets (Premium / LE) to start. Score jackpots at the left orbit, U-turn, and right ramp, and use the nuke launcher to score super jackpots and add balls.
- Vault Multiball — spell VAULT by hitting the shots lit to collect VAULT letters. Then hit the jump ramp twice to start Find the Lunchbox (Pro — hit any shot then the scoop within a short time limit), or a random Vault Experiment (Premium / LE — use the magna-flip and follow the display instructions). Vault Multiball is awarded from odd-numbered lunchboxes. Shoot the lit jackpot that moves from left to right with each shot. Then score a double jackpot at the upper loop (Pro) or magna-flip area (Premium / LE) to light the super jackpot at the jump ramp.
- Leveling up / SPECIAL — complete game tasks to earn XP. Then shoot the Pip-Boy to collect a SPECIAL perk. Each character starts with 2 perks already obtained.
- Radio modes — hit the radio tower to light various shots for radio modes. The shot that starts the mode is the "focus shot" of each mode that stays lit and always builds / advances towards the radio jackpot at the radio tower target. The jackpot is multiplied every time one is earned. Great to have going with other modes.
- Radaway hurry-up / jackpot — hit radroaches to spawn green radaway shots for a short time. Collect enough to enable the Pip-Boy to start radaway hurry-up, where the upper Pip-Boy shot, jump ramp, and right ramp collect the value. Completing all three shots lights the upper loop to score repeatable radaway jackpots worth the total of all three hurry-ups for 10 seconds. Massive scoring but difficult to pull off.
- Sundries — earn caps to enable sundries. Either purchase items with caps or steal items. If the steal fails, shoot the right ramp to escape, though the items will cost 2x the next time you visit sundries.
- Power armor — shoot the targets above the pop bumper to increase power armor %, or earn fusion cores from sundries to increase it. Hold the action button when flashing red to activate power armor and start 2x scoring for as long as power armor is active. Good to use in Deathclaw multiball 2 or during multiball + mode + radio stacks.
